scope: DEV_A T0/T1 paired and DEV_B T1 absolute evaluation; no T2 or TRANSFER

alignment.rotation_initialization: 24 proper axis-aligned rotations after PCA canonicalization
alignment.selection: minimum symmetric Chamfer on 4096 deterministic samples
alignment.caveat: registration removes pose error because generated parts have no registered local frame

normalization: GT axis-aligned bbox diagonal after rigid alignment

quality_gate.decision: PASS only if every criterion passes; otherwise LOCAL_REPAIR, or REPLAN when IoU < 0.15 or critical feature recall < 0.5

mechanical_feature_metric.limitation: measures executable trace coverage, not perceptual or geometric correctness; Phase 6 review must assess the latter
